newsitem.title: UK: GEC set to signal spin-offs - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC set to signal spin-offs - paper.

text.p: British electronics giant General Electric Co Plc (GEC) will signal its intention to spin-off GEC-Alsthom and GPT when it unveils its long-awaited strategtic review on Tuesday, said the Observer newspaper on Sunday.
The newspaper quoted a "senior GEC source" saying that the exit from the powers and telecoms joint ventures "may not spelled out in black and white just yet".
GEC-Alstom is a joint venture between General Electric and France's Alcatel Alsthom, while its telecoms venture GPT is with Germany electronics and engineering group Siemens AG.
GEC is also due to unveil annual profits on Tuesday with analysts predicting pretax profits of between 1.0 billion and 1.55 billion pounds ($2.6 billion) compared with 981 million last year.
